title: Vehicle Maintenance Shop, Kadena Air Base, Okinawa, Japan
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > POD > W2SN ENDIST JAPAN
description:
This is a request for proposal (RFP) for the construction of a new vehicle maintenance shop and supporting facilities at Kadena Air Base, Okinawa, Japan. A firm-fixed price construction contract will be awarded based on a tradeoff source selection approach in which the non-price factors are approximately equal to the price factor. The work will include substantial earthworks, demolition of existing structures, and new construction. Please review all attachments. 

 A site visit was held on 10 November 2026. The attendee sign-in sheet is attached.
